verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented training opt-out, no-training data policy, or data-retention control from Cline. Running local models through Ollama or LM Studio and bringing your own provider keys could keep data away from Cline's hosted gateway, but these are adjacent model-routing features rather than a documented control over training use, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
